observations: Two vintage-style road bicycles leaning against a wire fence.
The front bicycle has a white/silver frame, white saddle, and white handlebar tape.
The rear bicycle has a black frame with 'YAMAHA' printed on the down tube (photo 0).
A large watermark 'STACEY DAVIES' is centered across the image.
The tires on both bicycles appear aged, with significant browning and weathering on the sidewalls.
The background shows a stack of used car tires and a paved/dirt area.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows tires with heavy weathering and dirt on the sidewalls.

risks.risk: The photo may be stolen from a professional photographer's portfolio.
risks.proof: A photo of the bicycles with a handwritten note showing the current date and the seller's name.

risks.risk: Mechanical components (gears, brakes) may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the pedals turning and gears shifting through all positions.

risks.risk: Tires and tubes may be dry-rotted and unusable.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tire sidewalls and tread.

proof_requests: Photo of the bicycles with a handwritten note of today's date and your name to verify possession.
Close-up photos of the gear systems, derailleurs, and brakes for both bikes.
Video of the wheels spinning and gears shifting.
Clear photos of the brand markings on the white bicycle's frame.
response.reason: The presence of a professional watermark 'STACEY DAVIES' suggests the image is not original to the seller. Additionally, the seller's claim of the items being 'very clean' is contradicted by the visible weathering and dirt on the tires in the photo.
